import sys, json
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
turns = d.get("messages", [])
call = next((t for t in turns if t.get("type") == "tool_call"), None)
cid = call.get("id","") if call else ""
# Task 6: deterministic ~40 KB tool_result. Over 2 iterations the cumulative
# collector->/llm fire body exceeds the 65536-byte blob_inline_max_bytes default,
# so A8 offloads the whole body as Body::Blob.
text = "X" * 40000
out = {"header":{"route":"c_res"},
       "messages":[{"origin":"tool","type":"tool_result","id":cid,"text":text}]}
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(out))
